highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0 previews a major engine and platform refresh with a streamlined modern API.
highlights_body: The release adds modern span-based APIs and expanded desktop, mobile, and web support. Review the breaking changes before migrating from 2.x.

breaking.title: Legacy obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: Members that were previously marked obsolete are no longer available. Update callers to the replacement APIs before moving from SkiaSharp 2.x.

bullets.lead: Skia and bundled graphics dependencies were refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates the renderer and bundled image and text dependencies for the 3.0 preview line.
Adds SKBlender, Skottie animation building, raw shaders, picture recording APIs, and span-based overloads for common graphics operations.

bullets.lead: Platform view and GPU support expanded
bullets.detail: Adds accelerated WinUI and WPF elements, modernizes Mac Catalyst rendering, and improves WebAssembly and Uno view support.
Corrects Metal snapshots, XAML canvas behavior, cloned paint disposal, text kerning, and pixel access behavior.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Uno and WebAssembly canvas reliability improvements
contributor_summaries.Youssef1313: Span overloads and Uno rendering fixes

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 introduced the SkiaSharp 3.0 line and its modernized platform foundation.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 expanded graphics APIs and improved WebAssembly, Uno, and XAML view behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added more drawing APIs, platform support, and renderer updates.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 continued the engine refresh with compatibility and resource-lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 prepared the first public 3.0 preview with final platform and packaging refinements.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes bundled HarfBuzz and aligns generated bindings with the modernized 3.0 platform and interop work.
